def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor, **kwargs):
        previous_dtype = x.dtype

        if self.active_adapter not in self.lora_A.keys():   # No adapter, directly use linear
            return F.linear(x, transpose(self.weight, self.fan_in_fan_out), bias=self.bias)
        if self.disable_adapters:   # No adapter
            if self.r[self.active_adapter] > 0 and self.merged: # merge the adapter to linear
                self.unmerge()
            result = F.linear(x, transpose(self.weight, self.fan_in_fan_out), bias=self.bias)
        elif self.r[self.active_adapter] > 0 :   # general lora process
            result = F.linear(x, transpose(self.weight, self.fan_in_fan_out), bias=self.bias)
            x = x.to(self.lora_A[self.active_adapter].loraA[0].weight.dtype)

            #<---------------------------Seperable Mixture of LoRA------------------------------->
            self.lora_vu_gate = self.lora_vu_gate.to(x.device)
            self.lora_ins_gate = self.lora_ins_gate.to(x.device)
            current_ins_emb = torch.tensor(self.ins_emb).to(x.device)
            current_ins_emb = current_ins_emb.to(x.dtype)

            # calculate vu_router
            x_emb = torch.mean(x, dim=1, keepdim=True)
            vu_router = self.lora_vu_gate[self.active_adapter](x_emb)
            top1_vu_router = torch.zeros_like(vu_router)
            max_values, max_indices = torch.max(vu_router, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
            top1_vu_router.scatter_(-1, max_indices, 1.0)

            # calculate if_router
            if_router = self.lora_ins_gate[self.active_adapter](current_ins_emb[self.ins_type])
            top1_if_router = torch.zeros_like(if_router)
            max_values, max_indices = torch.max(if_router, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
            top1_if_router.scatter_(-1, max_indices, 1.0)
            top1_if_router = top1_if_router.expand(top1_vu_router.size(0), -1)


            final_router = torch.cat((top1_vu_router, top1_if_router.unsqueeze(1)), dim=-1)
            self.final_router = final_router
            vu_result = 0.0
            if_result = 0.0
            for i in range(self.expert_num//2):
                vu_result += ( # lora process
                    self.lora_B[self.active_adapter].loraB[i](
                        self.lora_A[self.active_adapter].loraA[i](self.lora_dropout[self.active_adapter](x)),
                    )
                    * self.scaling[self.active_adapter]
                    * final_router[:,:,i].unsqueeze(-1)
                )
            
            for i in range(self.expert_num//2, self.expert_num):
                if_result += ( # lora process
                    self.lora_B[self.active_adapter].loraB[i](
                        self.lora_A[self.active_adapter].loraA[i](self.lora_dropout[self.active_adapter](x)),
                    )
                    * self.scaling[self.active_adapter]
                    * final_router[:,:,i].unsqueeze(-1)
                )
            

            score_A = self.lora_fc_A[self.active_adapter](vu_result)  # [B, n, 1]
            score_B = self.lora_fc_B[self.active_adapter](if_result)  # [B, n, 1]

            scores = torch.cat([score_A, score_B], dim=-1)  # [B, n, 2]
            attention_weights = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)  # [B, n, 2]
            self.attention_weights = attention_weights

            alpha_A = attention_weights[:, :, 0].unsqueeze(-1)  # [B, n, 1]
            alpha_B = attention_weights[:, :, 1].unsqueeze(-1)  # [B, n, 1]

            A_weighted = alpha_A * vu_result  # [B, n, k]
            B_weighted = alpha_B * if_result  # [B, n, k]
            result += (A_weighted + B_weighted) # [B, n, k]

        else:
            result = F.linear(x, transpose(self.weight, self.fan_in_fan_out), bias=self.bias)

        result = result.to(previous_dtype)

        return result
